title: everyday parts: a pulley, a grooved shaft, a sheet metal bracket, a slotted plate, a mirrored part, a snap box, a filleted pocket, a three-section loft

cases.name: c001
cases.description: a pulley: a profile (radius 25, 12 wide, a V groove 6 deep and 8 across its rim, a hub of radius 8 standing 5 out each side) revolved, a bore (radius 4) with a 2 × 1.5 keyway

cases.name: c002
cases.description: a shaft (radius 8, 60 long along x) with a groove (2 wide, 1 deep) turned at x = 20, a cross hole (radius 2) through at x = 40, its ends chamfered 0.8

cases.name: c003
cases.description: a sheet metal bracket: a 40 × 30 plate (2 thick) with a flange 25 up on its far edge, a hole (radius 2.5) in the flange patterned 3 along it at 10

cases.name: c004
cases.description: a disc (radius 30, 4 thick) with an obround slot (12 long, 4 wide) at 18 from its centre patterned 6 round it

cases.name: c005
cases.description: a 30 × 20 × 10 block with a 10 × 10 × 8 lug on its end at x = 30, mirrored across x = 0 and united

cases.name: c006
cases.description: a snap box: a 40 × 30 × 15 box shelled 1.5 open at its top, a tab (6 wide, 1.5 thick, 5 tall) standing up from its rim at y = 0, a hole (radius 1) through the tab

cases.name: c007
cases.description: a 50 × 40 × 12 block with an obround pocket (30 × 16, 8 deep), its walls' top edge filleted 1 all round (a tangent chain) and its floor edge 2 all round

cases.name: c008
cases.description: a loft through a 20 × 20 square at z = 0, a circle of radius 8 at z = 15 and a 10 × 10 square at z = 30
